slides.title: Golf starts at midnight
slides.body: PGA Tour, LIV Golf Korea, and DP World Tour all tee off at 12:00 AM ET.

slides.title: MLB all afternoon
slides.body: Angels-Tigers at 1:10 PM ET, Twins-White Sox at 2:10 PM ET, then Braves-Red Sox at 4:10 PM ET.

slides.title: More baseball at night
slides.body: Blue Jays-Orioles, Cubs-Pirates, and Astros-Rangers all hit the late window.

slides.title: WNBA doubleheader
slides.body: Aces-Wings at 8:00 PM ET on Amazon Prime, then Fever-Valkyries at 10:00 PM ET.

slides.title: Prime time NBA
slides.body: Thunder-Spurs tips at 8:30 PM ET on NBC and Peacock.
